title: Collect Scouting Map: Into the Shadowlands

nodes.text: Buy Scouting Map: Into the Shadowlands from vendor NPC #6566. Check the displayed price and make the purchase yourself.

recovery.text: If the vendor does not sell it, check the listed faction, profession and quest prerequisites. Stock and costs are observed; Toybox never buys it for you.

nodes.text: Use Scouting Map: Into the Shadowlands from your bags to learn the toy.
